photo.entryHint: Upload a photo and see our floors in it.
photo.drop: Drop a photo of your room here
photo.privacy: Your photo stays on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
photo.tip1: Stand in a doorway or corner and hold the phone level, at chest height.
photo.tip2: Show as much floor as possible; landscape photos work best.
photo.tip3: Use daylight and switch off strongly coloured lamps.
photo.error.heic: This browser cannot open HEIC photos. Open this page on the iPhone or iPad, or save the photo as JPEG.
photo.error.unreadable: This file could not be opened as a photo.
photo.error.small: This photo is too small. Use at least 480 pixels on the short side.
photo.aiDone: The floor is marked in green. Paint over anything missing and erase anything that is not floor.
photo.aiFailed: Automatic floor detection is not available right now. Paint the floor with the brush.
photo.aiEmpty: No floor was found. Paint the floor with the brush.
photo.snapHint: The brush only paints colours like the one under its centre, so it stops at furniture and walls.
photo.perspectiveHint: Drag the four yellow corners onto a rectangle on the floor — along a wall, a rug or the plank lines. The white lines show the size of the new planks.
photo.horizonError: All four corners must be on the floor, below the horizon.
photo.floorsOnly: Only the floor changes in your photo; doors and skirting stay as they are.
photo.limits: Strong patterns of the old floor may still show faintly.
